dataStream.name: deviceSupport
dataStream.sql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "warrantyCoverageStatus" = 'success') AS DOUBLE) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), CAST(0 AS DOUBLE)) AS "covered" FROM "dataset"

config.description: Share of devices with a vendor warranty record whose warranty is still active
config.title: Under Warranty

dataStream.name: deviceSupport
dataStream.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "warrantyCoverageStatus" = 'error' OR "daysUntilWarrantyExpiry" < 0) AS "expired", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "daysUntilWarrantyExpiry" BETWEEN 0 AND 90) AS "expiring" FROM "dataset"

config.description: Devices whose warranty has expired, and those expiring in the next 90 days
config.title: Warranty Risk

dataStream.name: deviceSupport
dataStream.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "salesAvailability" = 'error') AS "endOfSale", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "lastSupportStatus" = 'error') AS "endOfSupport" FROM "dataset"

config.description: Devices the vendor no longer sells, and devices past their last date of vendor support
config.title: End of Life

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b."deviceId" IS NOT NULL AND b."ageDays" > 7) AS "stale", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b."deviceId" IS NULL) AS "missing" FROM "devices" d LEFT JOIN "backups" b ON b."deviceId" = d."id" WHERE d."deviceType" IN ('switch','l3Switch','router','firewall','controller','stack','loadBalancer','utm','securityAppliance','voipSwitch')

config.description: Switches, routers, firewalls and controllers whose running config backup is over 7 days old, or missing altogether
config.title: Backup Gaps

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT 'Warranty' AS "contract", 1 AS "o", "warrantyCoverageStatus" AS "h" FROM "warranty" UNION ALL SELECT 'Service contract', 2, "serviceCoverageStatus" FROM "warranty" UNION ALL SELECT 'Sales', 3, "salesAvailability" FROM "lifecycle" UNION ALL SELECT 'Software maintenance', 4, "softwareMaintenanceStatus" FROM "lifecycle" UNION ALL SELECT 'Security patches', 5, "securitySoftwareMaintenanceStatus" FROM "lifecycle" UNION ALL SELECT 'Vendor support', 6, "lastSupportStatus" FROM "lifecycle"), t AS (SELECT "contract", "o", CASE "h" WHEN 'success' THEN 'Active' WHEN 'warning' THEN 'Limited' WHEN 'error' THEN 'Expired' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "status" FROM s), st AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0, 'Active'), (1, 'Limited'), (2, 'Expired'), (3, 'Unknown')) v("so", "status")), c AS (SELECT DISTINCT "contract", "o" FROM t) SELECT c."contract", st."status", CAST(COUNT(t."status") AS DOUBLE) AS "devices" FROM c CROSS JOIN st LEFT JOIN t ON t."contract" = c."contract" AND t."status" = st."status" GROUP BY c."contract", c."o", st."status", st."so" ORDER BY c."o", st."so"

config.description: Devices with vendor records by status of each warranty, service and lifecycle contract
config.title: Contract Scorecard

dataStream.name: deviceSupport
dataStream.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'Expired'), (2, 'Next 30 days'), (3, '31–90 days'), (4, '3–6 months'), (5, '6–12 months'), (6, 'Over a year'), (7, 'No date')) v("o", "window")), w AS (SELECT CASE WHEN "daysUntilWarrantyExpiry" IS NULL THEN 'No date' WHEN "daysUntilWarrantyExpiry" < 0 THEN 'Expired' WHEN "daysUntilWarrantyExpiry" <= 30 THEN 'Next 30 days' WHEN "daysUntilWarrantyExpiry" <= 90 THEN '31–90 days' WHEN "daysUntilWarrantyExpiry" <= 182 THEN '3–6 months' WHEN "daysUntilWarrantyExpiry" <= 365 THEN '6–12 months' ELSE 'Over a year' END AS "window" FROM "dataset") SELECT b."window", CAST(COUNT(w."window") AS DOUBLE) AS "devices" FROM b LEFT JOIN w ON w."window" = b."window" GROUP BY b."o", b."window" ORDER BY b."o"

config.description: Devices by when their warranty expires, from already expired to more than a year away
config.title: Warranty Runway

dataSourceConfig.sql: SELECT l."deviceName" AS "device", l."salesAvailability" AS "sales", l."softwareMaintenanceStatus" AS "software", l."securitySoftwareMaintenanceStatus" AS "security", l."lastSupportStatus" AS "support", d."link", (CASE WHEN l."lastSupportStatus" = 'error' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN l."securitySoftwareMaintenanceStatus" = 'error' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN l."softwareMaintenanceStatus" = 'error' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN l."salesAvailability" = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "risk" FROM "lifecycle" l LEFT JOIN "devices" d ON d."id" = l."deviceId" ORDER BY "risk" DESC, "device" LIMIT 30

config.description: Vendor sales, software maintenance, security patch and support status for each device, worst first. Click a row to open the device in Auvik
config.title: Lifecycle Matrix

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT COALESCE(d."vendorName", 'Unknown vendor') AS "vendor", CASE WHEN w."deviceId" IS NOT NULL THEN 'Tracked' ELSE 'Untracked' END AS "state" FROM "devices" d LEFT JOIN "warranty" w ON w."deviceId" = d."id"), top AS (SELECT "vendor", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 10), st AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0, 'Tracked'), (1, 'Untracked')) v("so", "state")) SELECT top."vendor", st."state", CAST(COUNT(x."state") AS DOUBLE) AS "devices" FROM top CROSS JOIN st LEFT JOIN x ON x."vendor" = top."vendor" AND x."state" = st."state" GROUP BY top."vendor", top."n", st."state", st."so" ORDER BY top."n" DESC, top."vendor", st."so"

config.description: Devices per vendor that Auvik has warranty data for (tracked) and those it has none for (untracked), for the 10 largest vendors
config.title: Vendor Blind Spots

dataStream.name: configurationBackups
dataStream.sql: WITH ids AS (SELECT "deviceName", "deviceId", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "deviceName" ORDER BY "deviceId") AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "deviceName") AS dup FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "deviceName", "deviceId" FROM "dataset")) SELECT CASE WHEN i.dup > 1 THEN d."deviceName" || ' #' || i.rn ELSE d."deviceName" END AS "device", CAST(d."ageDays" AS DOUBLE) AS "age" FROM "dataset" d JOIN ids i ON d."deviceId" = i."deviceId" WHERE d."ageDays" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "age" DESC LIMIT 10

config.description: Age in days of each device's current running config backup, oldest first. Amber after 7 days, red after 30
config.title: Oldest Backups

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT CASE WHEN d."deviceType" = 'ups' THEN 'UPS' WHEN d."deviceType" IS NULL OR d."deviceType" = 'unknown' THEN 'Unclassified' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(d."deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(d."deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END AS "type", CASE WHEN b."deviceId" IS NULL THEN 'No backup' WHEN b."ageDays" <= 7 THEN 'Within 7 days' WHEN b."ageDays" <= 30 THEN '8–30 days' ELSE 'Over 30 days' END AS "backup" FROM "devices" d LEFT JOIN "backups" b ON b."deviceId" = d."id" WHERE d."deviceType" IN ('switch','l3Switch','router','firewall','controller','stack','loadBalancer','utm','securityAppliance','voipSwitch')), t AS (SELECT "type", COUNT(*) AS "n" FROM x GROUP BY 1), st AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES (0, 'Within 7 days'), (1, '8–30 days'), (2, 'Over 30 days'), (3, 'No backup')) v("so", "backup")) SELECT t."type", st."backup", CAST(COUNT(x."backup") AS DOUBLE) AS "devices" FROM t CROSS JOIN st LEFT JOIN x ON x."type" = t."type" AND x."backup" = st."backup" GROUP BY t."type", t."n", st."backup", st."so" ORDER BY t."n" DESC, t."type", st."so"

config.description: Network devices by device type and the age of their running config backup
config.title: Backup Coverage

dataSourceConfig.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT d."name" AS "device", CASE WHEN d."deviceType" = 'ups' THEN 'UPS' WHEN d."deviceType" IS NULL OR d."deviceType" = 'unknown' THEN 'Unclassified' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(d."deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 1, 1)) || SUBSTR(REGEXP_REPLACE(d."deviceType", '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g'), 2) END AS "type", TRIM(COALESCE(d."vendorName", '') || ' ' || COALESCE(d."makeModel", '')) AS "model", d."tenantName" AS "site", d."link", w."warrantyCoverageStatus" AS "wh", w."warrantyExpirationDate" AS "expires", w."daysUntilWarrantyExpiry" AS "days", w."serviceCoverageStatus" AS "sh", l."salesAvailability" AS "saleh", l."lastSupportStatus" AS "suph" FROM "devices" d LEFT JOIN "warranty" w ON w."deviceId" = d."id" LEFT JOIN "lifecycle" l ON l."deviceId" = d."id" WHERE w."deviceId" IS NOT NULL OR l."deviceId" IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN "suph" = 'error' THEN 'End of support' WHEN "wh" = 'error' OR "days" < 0 THEN 'Warranty expired' WHEN "days" <= 90 THEN 'Expiring soon' WHEN "sh" = 'error' THEN 'Service expired' WHEN "saleh" = 'error' THEN 'End of sale' WHEN "wh" = 'success' AND "suph" = 'success' THEN 'Covered' ELSE 'Unverified' END AS "risk" FROM j) SELECT "risk", "device", "type", "model", "site", CASE "wh" WHEN 'success' THEN 'Covered' WHEN 'warning' THEN 'Limited' WHEN 'error' THEN 'Expired' WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE 'No record' END AS "warranty", "expires", CASE "sh" WHEN 'success' THEN 'Covered' WHEN 'warning' THEN 'Limited' WHEN 'error' THEN 'Expired' WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE 'No record' END AS "service", CASE "suph" WHEN 'success' THEN 'Supported' WHEN 'warning' THEN 'Limited' WHEN 'error' THEN 'Ended' WHEN 'unknown' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE 'No record' END AS "support", "link" FROM r ORDER BY CASE "risk" WHEN 'End of support' THEN 0 WHEN 'Warranty expired' THEN 1 WHEN 'Expiring soon' THEN 2 WHEN 'Service expired' THEN 3 WHEN 'End of sale' THEN 4 WHEN 'Unverified' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, "days" NULLS LAST, "device"

config.description: Every device with a vendor warranty or lifecycle record, worst risk first. Click a row to open the device in Auvik
config.title: Devices at Risk
